FINDINGS:

There is a small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cyst.

There is mild thinning and superficial fraying of the cartilage involving all 3 compartments. There are no regions of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There is intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and posterior on of the medial meniscus without tear. The lateral meniscus demonstrates intrasubstance degeneration of the posterior horn and body with a focal horizontal tear of the body extending to the inferior articular surface. There is no displaced meniscal fragment.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Mild degenerative changes involving all 3 compartments with no regions of full-thickness cartilage loss.

2. Intrasubstance degeneration of the medial and lateral meniscus with a horizontal tear of the body of the lateral meniscus as above.

3. Small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

FINDINGS:

There is a moderate knee joint effusion with synovitis. There is no popliteal cysts.

There are focal severe degenerative change at the patellofemoral joint with full-thickness cartilage loss involving the lateral patellar facet and median ridge with subchondral reactive changes. There is also moderate thinning involving the central and lateral aspect of femoral trochlea. There is a diffuse mild thinning and superficial fraying involving the medial and lateral compartment most pronounced medially.

There is intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus without a well-defined linear tear. The lateral meniscus is unremarkable.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Focal severe degenerative change at the patellofemoral joint with mild changes in the medial and lateral compartments. Associated joint effusion without popliteal cyst.
2. Intrasubstance degeneration of the medial meniscus without a well-defined linear tear.
3. No ligament injury.

There is a minor knee effusion. There is tearing of the posteromedial corner and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  AT FL is markedly attenuated in size but retains an element of structural continuity. Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellar articular cartilage is normal. There is a focal 6 mm area of cartilage loss within the trochlear groove.  
Conclusion: Tearing of the medial meniscus. Old partial ACL injury.

[DATE]: Klinische inlichtingen: Pijn bij traplopen. Vermoeden van kruisbandpathologie en chondropathie. MRI knie Links: 3 T onderzoek. Sagittale protondensiteit opnamen en T2-gewogen opnamen met fatsat. Coronale T1-gewogen opnamen en T2-gewogen opnamen met fatsat. Axiale T2-gewogen opnamen met fatsat. Bespreking: Normaal aspect van de quadricepspees. Geen manifeste hydrops suprapatellair. Bewaard patellofemoraal gewricht. Geen manifeste graad 3/graad 4 kraakbeenletsels patellofemoraal. Normaal aspect van mediale en laterale retinaculum patellae. Normaal aspect van de patellapees. Lichte opzetting van de inferieure patellaire bursa. Enkele strengformaties centraal in het vetplan van Hoffa. Bewaarde femorotibiale gewrichten. Vlekkig botpatroon endomedullair in distale femur: verhoogde hoeveelheid rood beenmerg? Geen manifeste graad 3/graad 4 kraakbeenletsels femorotibiaal. Beperkt vernauwd voorkomen van het mediale femorotibiale compartiment. Normaal aspect van de laterale meniscus. Lichte tendinose van de aanhechting van de popliteuspees. Normaal aspect van mediale meniscus. Normaal aspect van het mediale collaterale ligament, laterale collaterale ligament en tractus iliotibialis. Discrete bursa semimembranosa gastrocnemia. Beperkt vrij vocht in de fossa poplitea. Lichte tendinose van de femorale aanhechting van de musculus gastrocnemius medialis met kleine intratendineuze scheur aldaar (Serie 10, Beeld 11) . BESLUIT: Geen manifeste graad 3/graad 4 kraakbeenletsels aantoonbaar. Geen argumenten voor meniscusscheur. Lichte tendinose van de femorale aanhechting van de musculus gastrocnemius medialis met kleine intratendineuze scheur aldaar.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rodilla traumática aguda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colateral lateral sin alteraciones.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal del componente superficial y profundo del complejo nervio
medial en su aspecto proximal con pérdida parcial de la continuidad de sus fibras y edema las
partes blandas regionales. El resto de los componentes del complejo medial sin alteraciones.
Aumento de señal central periférico del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial
que no impresiona contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de platillo tibial lateral. El resto de los cartílagos
femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total
de la rótula de distribución difusa.
Leve a moderado derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Signos de un esguince grado II del aspecto proximal del complejo ligamentario medial con edema
de las partes blandas regionales.
Condropatía superficial de platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía rotuliana con lesiones grado 2 y 3 de distribución difusa.
Leve a moderado derrame articular

Central supporting system  
 - Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Full thickness tear at proximal insertion to mid part of ACL. 
 - Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Buckling PCL is noted.  
 - Anterior tibial translation is measured 13.0 mm.  
  
 Medial compartment  
 - Medial meniscus: Horizontal tear at body to posterior horn of medial meniscus extending peripherally and tear at posterior root. Parameniscal cyst is observed, measured 4 mm in diameter.  
 - Medial collateral ligament: Preserved.  
 - Medial tibial plateau: Focal grade-2 chondrosis of articular cartilage at medial tibial plateau with normal marrow SI.  
 - Medial femoral condyle: Normal marrow SI and articular cartilage.  
  
 Lateral compartment  
 - Lateral meniscus: No definite tear. No discoid meniscus.  
 - Iliotibial band: Normal.  
 - Lateral collateral ligament: Abnormal intermediate SI on T2W of proximal part of LCL; suggested sprain.  
 - Popliteus tendon: Normal.  
 - Popliteofibular ligament: Normal.  
 - Biceps femoris tendon : Preserved.  
 - Lateral tibial plateau: Normal marrow SI and articular cartilage.  
 - Lateral femoral condyle: Grade-3 chondrosis of articular cartilage at weight-baring lateral femoral condyle without subchondral bone edema.  
  
 Patellofemoral compartment  
 - Quadriceps tendon: Normal.  
 - Patellar tendon: Normal.  
 - Medial patellar retinaculum: Normal.  
 - Lateral patellar retinaculum: Normal.  
  
 Others  
 - Fibrous thickening at distal vatus lateralis tendon without edema; suspected previous strain. 
 - Fluid within lateral patellofemoral joint which extends to lateral gutter with mild synovial thickening is observed; suggested mild synovitis.  
 - Muscles appear unremarkable.  
 - Neurovascular bundles are intact.  - Full thickness tear at proximal insertion to mid part of right ACL with anterior tibial translation about 13.0 mm.  
 - Horizontal tear at body to posterior horn of right medial meniscus extending peripherally and tear at posterior root with parameniscal cyst, 4 mm.  
 - Focal grade-2 chondrosis at right medial tibial plateau. 
 - Right lateral collateral ligament sprain.  
 - Grade-3 chondrosis at weight-baring lateral femoral condyle. 
 - Fibrous thickening at distal vatus lateralis tendon without edema; suspected previous strain. 
 - Mild synovitis of lateral patellofemoral joint, extending to lateral gutter.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Medial menisküste gövde ve posterior grade III dejenerasyon mevcuttur.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ligaman normaldir. Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde hafif sıvı artışı izlendi(grade I sprain).Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellar kıkırdakta medial fasette incelme, komşu kemik yapılarda milimetrik ödem izlenmişti (Tip 4 kondromalazi ).Patellofemoral diz eklem düzeyinde sıvı artışları izlenmiştir.Suprapatellar bursada sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Diz eklemi oluşturan komşu kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler , eklem mesafesinde kayıp izlendi. Ayrıca tibia ve femoral kartilajlarda yer yer incelmeler ve bütünlük kaybı mevcuttur(dejeneratif artit bulguları).Gastroknemius kası medial bacağı tendonunda tendinozis bulguları mevcuttur.Popliteal fossada 35x 5 mm çapta baker kisti izlendi.Tibia interkondiler tüberkül eminensi ACL insersiyo düzeyinde subkondral milimetrik kist izlendi.

Fortgeschrittene, lateral betonte Pangonarthrose mit lateral flächig in der Belastungszone vollschichtiger Chondropathie beider Gelenkpartner und subkortikalen Ödemarealen. Außenmeniskus extrudiert mit mukoider Auffaserung der Pars intermedia sowie insbesondere des Vorderhorns. Die VH-Wurzel dabei nicht mehr nachvollziebar und aufgefasert im Gelenk liegend. Kein Ganglion bei gering flüssigkeitsgefülltem Recessus (6/27). Teils tiefergehende Chondropathie auch medial mit gering mukoidem Innenmeniskus ohne umschriebene Rissbildung. VKB gering mukoid und MCL mit geringem Reizzustand, ansonsten Bandapparat intakt. Dtl. Femoropatellararthrose, führend an der lateralen retropatellaren Facette sowie medialen Trochlea mit fokal tiefergehender Chondropathie und gering lateralisiert stehender Patella. Geringe Insertionstendinopathie der Patellarsehne am Unterpol. Mäßiger Erguss mit Reizsynovialitis. V.a. freien Gelenkkörper im lateralen Recessus suprapatellaris (9/18) sowie verkalkte Gelenkkörper am dorsomedialen Tibiaplateau (CC 13 mm, 6/10). Baker-Zyste mit CC 4,3 cm.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Assess for anterior cruciate ligament tear left knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. Large radial tear posterior horn medial meniscus measuring at least 7 mm, with slight peripheral extrusion of the medial meniscal body. Intrasubstance degeneration within the medial meniscal body without evidence of additional tear. The posterior root and anterior horn are intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament and biceps femoris tendon insertion are intact. Moderate popliteus tendinosis without tear. Iliotibial band is intact.

Attenuated appearance of the medial patellofemoral ligament suggestive of prior tear. No patellofemoral subluxation. The lateral patellar retinaculum is intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Fissuring of articular cartilage central to medial femoral trochlea as well as overlying the medial patellar facet. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Baker's cyst, with cyst fluid tracking distally along the medial superficial fascia of the medial head of the gastrocnemius muscle consistent with cyst leakage. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Large radial tear posterior horn medial meniscus with medial meniscal extrusion.
2. Suspected prior tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament without patellofemoral subluxation.
3. Focal moderate chondrosis at the medial aspect of the patellofemoral compartment.
4. Leaking Baker's cyst.

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales con condropatía superficial. Cartílago troclear sin
alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la faceta lateral y
vértice de la rótula.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Aumento de
señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales.
Condropatía lesiones grado dos y tres de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal. Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal
